oral_examination.oral_examination: Poor oral hygiene, tartar, soft plaque, pigment, obvious redness and swelling of the gums, bleeding at the gum margin, no periodontal pockets, and no obvious loosening of the teeth.

diagnosis.primary: Gingivitis. Treatment plan—Full-mouth ultrasonic supragingival scaling.

treatment_plan.notes: It is forbidden to eat foods with pigments within two days, and instructions on how to brush teeth will be provided, and any discomfort will be followed up.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Full mouth ultrasonic supragingival scaling and polishing. OHI oral hygiene education, education on brushing teeth, flossing, and using interstitial brushes.
